name: Chain links
oneLiner: 2 to 6 glass plates (glyph tile, label, number) arrive one by one, each joined to the last by a real chrome chain that clinks in link by link through riveted eyelets; then the chain pulls taut and a glint runs down it lighting every plate in the accent, or (weak set) one link cracks red and the rest of the chain drops away
say: when the speaker says the parts only work together ("your topic, your packaging, your hook, your editing: every one has to work"): cut in on the first part, one plate per word. Set weak to the link that fails ("and if one breaks, the whole thing breaks"): the crack lands on that word
